hook.say: How well do you know Africa? Five questions, three seconds each. Number five surprises almost everyone!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What is the highest mountain in Africa?
questions.fact: Kilimanjaro, in Tanzania, rises 5,895 meters and stands all alone.
questions.sayAnswer: Kilimanjaro! It rises 5,895 meters in Tanzania, and it stands all alone, not in a mountain range.

questions.q: Which African country has the most people?
questions.fact: Nigeria is home to well over 200 million people.
questions.sayAnswer: Nigeria! It is home to well over 200 million people.

questions.q: Which is the largest country in Africa by area?
questions.fact: Algeria took the title in 2011, when Sudan split into two countries.
questions.sayAnswer: Algeria! It took the title in 2011, when Sudan split into two countries.

questions.q: Victoria Falls is on which river?
questions.fact: The falls are 1.7 km wide, on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.
questions.sayAnswer: The Zambezi! The falls are 1.7 kilometers wide, on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.

questions.q: Which country has more ancient pyramids than Egypt?
questions.fact: Sudan has more than 200 pyramids. Egypt has between 120 and 140.
questions.sayAnswer: Sudan! It has more than 200 ancient pyramids. Egypt has between 120 and 140.
